title: Managing Resources in MapleStory Worlds
author: MapleStory Worlds Creator Center
summary: Official guidance for classifying, storing, sharing, migrating, and versioning Maker resources while preserving the permissions needed by a world.

sections.title: Resource ownership
items: Identify the resource classification and owner before reuse.
Confirm that the project has the required access permissions.

sections.title: Storage and sharing
items: Keep reusable resources organized for predictable project access.
Share resources only with the intended collaborators and scopes.

sections.title: Migration and versions
items: Review references before moving a resource between projects or locations.
Account for version behavior when updating a dependency used by a released world.

notes: Original MPStorys structured summary verified against the official document on 2026-07-27.
steps: Validate references before migration or version updates.
